purpose: Re-rank first-order blind-memory gaps after the UP-HARDROCK matrix-driven ordinary probe without rewriting the v1 decision history.
inputs: UP-HARDROCK deterministic compact index before the v6 probe

campaign_state.interpretation: The first ordinary v6 probe produced the campaign's first explicit duplicate observation but remained materially high novelty. No seal condition advanced. The correct response is cross-shard re-ranking, not another immediate UP-HARDROCK batch.

newly_explicit_dimensions: produced concentrate versus customer-acceptable/saleable concentrate as a separate effective-supply state
project-level ramp guidance revisions as an Expectation trajectory rather than only pipeline forecasts or final outcomes
refined_dimensions: port parcel, customer acceptance and title-transfer timing between production, shipment and sales recognition
completed_probe.duplicate_signal: price-driven cut-off-grade, stockpile and mine-plan reoptimization materially repeated HR-H006 and was retained as duplicate rather than rewritten as novelty

UP-HARDROCK.remaining_first_order_gap: second-tier/failed project paths and project-specific expectation chains remain, but another immediate hard-rock probe would have lower cross-shard information gain after the effective-supply state chain was materially improved
UP-HARDROCK.seal_effect: none; latest batch is not low novelty

remaining_negative_space: production/wholesale/retail/registration/export/inventory differences and which vintage was actually knowable at the time
vehicle-segment and battery-size mix needed to translate vehicle counts into installed battery GWh
installed battery GWh versus contemporaneous cathode/chemistry mix and lithium material demand
expectation revisions when subsidy phase-down, credit policy, Tesla localization and model mix changed the demand path
DOWN-NEV.reason: After improving the supply-side effective-quantity chain, the largest first-order asymmetry in the 2019-2020 replay is now demand translation. Reported NEV activity cannot be treated as contemporaneous lithium demand without channel inventory, unit-intensity and chemistry semantics.

UP-CHEMICALS.reason: Conversion remains the next structural bridge, but demand translation should be tested first so any residual chemical-supply gap is selected against an improved two-sided balance rather than by upstream-only intuition.

probe_protocol.target: Translate reported vehicle market activity into point-in-time battery/material demand. Do not collect more policy headlines unless they alter the measurement or expectation chain.
inputs_forbidden: later outcomes used to rewrite historical demand expectations
probe_protocol.after_probe: Re-rank again before deciding whether UP-CHEMICALS remains next. A productive DOWN-NEV probe does not auto-authorize conversion work.
probe_protocol.seal_effect: Only an observed low-novelty batch can start a qualifying streak. No shard currently has one.
